result.summary: Found 2 major issues: content is cut off on the right side of the screen, and horizontal scrolling is implied but not clearly indicated to users.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off on the right side of the screen, making it impossible to see the full card without scrolling
issues.suggestion: Ensure all cards in horizontal scrollable sections are either fully visible or clearly indicate to users that the section is horizontally scrollable (e.g., with visual scroll indicators or by adjusting card widths)

issues.description: The category filter pills (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appear to continue off-screen to the right with no indication of additional categories or ability to scroll
issues.suggestion: Either display all category options visible without horizontal scrolling, or add a scroll indicator/arrow to show users there are more categories available
